en: A black‑and‑white view of a curving European street lined with tall, ornate late‑19th‑century apartment and hotel buildings featuring balconies, bay windows and steep roofs with small spires. On the right is a grand institutional or hotel building with classical detailing and a landscaped garden in front. A church with a spire is visible further back. People in early 20th‑century dress walk along the pavement and a horse‑drawn carriage stands in the street. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image.
